answer: Because the onyx count is verified against the gale text itself, the delta audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 68 aliases therefore means producing 68 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 4 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
